title: Presentation of a contracted-power extension
statement: For a scheme $X$ [def-pc-scheme], a Zariski abelian sheaf $G$ on $X$ [def-sc-zariski-site] and a $G$-torsor $T$ [def-sc-gm-torsor], a contracted-power extension presentation consists of coherent integer powers $T^{\otimes n}$ with maps $\mu_{m,n}$ [lem-sc-zariski-contracted-power-torsor], their sheaf coproduct $E=\coprod_{n\in\mathbf Z}T^{\otimes n}$ endowed with the abelian-sheaf law induced by $\mu_{m,n}$, and maps $G\to E\to\mathbf Z_X$ forming a short exact sequence. The natural summand maps identify $T^{\otimes n}$ with the fibre over the constant integer $n$, addition on summands is $[x,y]\mapsto\mu_{m,n}([x,y])$ in degree $m+n$, and the degree-zero summand is the inclusion of $G$. The degree-one fibre is canonically and equivariantly $T$ via $T^{\otimes1}=T$.
